## Production Projects & Systems
- [Enterprise Lead Funnels & Edge Proxies](https://sahillangoo.in/projects/enterprise-lead-funnels/): Distributed Hono API proxies, Experian credit-report OTP verification, and server-side Meta CAPI event routing.
- [smart-img-cli](https://sahillangoo.in/projects/smart-img-cli/): High-throughput image compression and local vision SLM (Gemma 2B via LM Studio) alt-text generation built with Bun.
- [SoulMedia Agency Platform](https://sahillangoo.in/projects/soulmedia-website/): Creative media platform with Strapi CMS, automated Schema.org structured data, and Cloudflare R2 asset storage.
- [Hotel Akbar Sonmarg](https://sahillangoo.in/projects/hotel-akbar-sonmarg/): Luxury hospitality portal built with Astro 7.2, DaisyUI v5, and zero-dependency build-time quality hooks.
- [Rooh Yaseen Editorial Portfolio](https://sahillangoo.in/projects/roohyaseen-portfolio/): High-end photography & cinematography portfolio for UK DoP Rooh Yaseen with zero-CLS video facades.
- [HackForce Tactical Storefront](https://sahillangoo.in/projects/hackforce-storefront/): Cybersecurity platform with static Pagefind client search indexing.
- [template-astro-daisy](https://sahillangoo.in/projects/template-astro-daisy/): Open-source developer template with daisyUI 5 and Tailwind v4.
- [KU Result Daemon](https://sahillangoo.in/projects/ku-result/): Automated Python daemon for university exam notifications.
- [Travel Kit Websites](https://sahillangoo.in/projects/travel-kit-websites/): Modular booking inquiry engine for destination tour operators.

## Technical Writing & Essays
- [Server-Side Meta CAPI with Cloudflare Workers](https://sahillangoo.in/blog/server-side-capi-cloudflare-workers/): Resilient event pipelines, SHA-256 Web Crypto hashing, and bypassing browser ad-blocker signal loss.
- [Offloading Third-Party Scripts with Partytown](https://sahillangoo.in/blog/offloading-third-party-scripts-partytown-astro/): Preserving 0ms TBT and 100 Lighthouse Performance by delegating GTM and Meta Pixel to Web Workers.
- [Local SLM Vision Pipelines with Bun and Gemma](https://sahillangoo.in/blog/local-slm-vision-pipelines-bun-gemma/): Running offline Gemma 2B vision inference with LM Studio and Bun for private, zero-cost SEO image tagging.
- [Eliminating Bot Spam with Cloudflare Turnstile](https://sahillangoo.in/blog/hardening-edge-security-turnstile-astro/): Privacy-preserving CAPTCHA replacement with serverless edge validation in Hono.
- [Architecting Ultra-Fast Static Systems with Astro](https://sahillangoo.in/blog/architecting-modern-astro-systems/): Islands architecture, zero-JS baseline, and content collections.
- [The Lost Art of Minimalist Software Engineering](https://sahillangoo.in/blog/the-lost-art-of-minimalist-engineering/): Why KISS and YAGNI are superpower engineering advantages.
- [Type-Safe Content Pipelines with Zod & Astro](https://sahillangoo.in/blog/type-safe-content-pipelines/): Catching schema drift and broken frontmatter at build time.
